title: 临时产物验证后再发布
summary: 长任务或媒体输出先写入受控 staging/temporary 位置，经真实解析与完整性检查后再复制/发布到用户目标；FFmpeg return code 或 progress=100% 不是持久成功的充分条件。
invariants: Formal output is staged before final delivery.
Validation includes existence, non-zero size, expected stream/codec structure and sane duration where applicable.
Final delivery occurs only after validation.
Temporary/staging output is deleted only after successful delivery or explicit cleanup.
Interrupted jobs leave a recoverable or explicitly cleanable state rather than ambiguous success.

provenance.note: Windows local smoke exercises verified-output rejection paths.
